parole.testo: Internationalism, ultimately from New Latin dys- and -plasia.
Borrowed from New Latin fermium, named after atomic physicist Enrico Fermi. For the surname see Fermi.

parole.significato: fungus belonging to the genera Coprinus, Coprinellus, Coprinopsis, Parasola
parole.testo: From hnoj (“dung”) + -ník, calque of generic name New Latin Coprinus, from Ancient Greek κόπρος (kópros, “excrement, dung”), i.e. “(mushroom growing in) dungy (places)”.

parole.significato: fungus belonging to the genus Inocybe
parole.testo: From vlákno (“fibre”) + -ica, partial calque of New Latin Inocybe, from Ancient Greek ἰνο- (ino-, “muscle, tendon, fibre”) + κύβη (kúbē, “head”).
